name: Town of Stony Point Day Camp
description_short: Town day camp for Stony Point residents from kindergarten graduates (age 5) to age 13, June 29 to August 7. The weekly rhythm includes bowling, days at the Stony Point town pool, a movie and a field trip such as Legoland or a water park.

fees.name: Bowling day (includes lunch)
fees.note: Weekly at Breakpoint Bowl; campers are dropped off and picked up there

notes: 2026 fee for the summer: first child $350, second $325, third and more $300. Open to Stony Point residents only (proof of residency required); 5 and 6 year olds need proof of kindergarten graduation. Registration online only (opened May 2, 2026), card payment. Weekly trip days cost extra and vary: The Castle $35, Legoland NY $35, Splashdown $40 (ages 8 to 13), Sky Zone $30, Boulders game $20, Darlington Beach $10. Lunch or ice cream money at the pool. The page gives no camp site or hours; ZIP is from the Town Hall address in the page footer (74 East Main Street).
